WN Yerevan ’26 is accepting applications for participation in the game exhibition and indie pitch
Published by
admin
Tags:
WN Yerevan’26
,
wnconf
On October 15-16, a business event
WN Yerevan’26
will take place in the capital of Armenia with the support of App2Top. The event will feature an exhibition of games from independent developers and an indie pitch. Here is what you need to do to attend.
Showcase
Developers wishing to participate in the exhibition need to pass a selection process first. They must
fill out an application
in advance and describe their game in detail: the genre, the theme, the platforms it’s being developed for, and so on. The more intriguing the project looks, the higher the chance of getting the “green light.”
To gain approval, developers must also have:
a working game build (at least a vertical slice or alpha version);
gameplay video;
a presentation about the game.
Applications are accepted until October 9, but we recommend submitting them as early as possible since the number of showcase spots is limited, and they may fill up before the deadline.
Participation in the exhibition is free. Approved developers will receive one STANDARD PASS ticket to WN Yerevan’26.
Indie Pitch
In addition to the exhibition, developers can participate in the indie pitch — a presentation where teams showcase their games directly to industry experts.
Immediately after the presentation, developers will receive feedback. Jury members will provide a detailed review of each project and offer advice.
To enter the indie pitch, you also need to
submit an application
by October 9. Note that the selection for the indie pitch will occur separately from the showcase, and there are even fewer spots available — hurry up.
***
More detailed information about the upcoming event can be found on the
WN Yerevan’26
website.
